# Claude as the intent classifier (generated by llm_baseline.py)

210 held-out, team-written phrases (105 ES, 105 PT), the same ones as the model card. Claude Haiku 4.5 on Bedrock, temperature 0; few-shot shows 2 training phrases per class and language.

| Classifier | Macro-F1 | ES | PT | Accuracy | Latency p50 | Cost per 1,000 messages |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| tfidf+logreg (shipped) | 0.853 | 0.797 | 0.905 | 0.852 | 0.3 ms | $0.00 |
| claude zero-shot | 0.890 | 0.896 | 0.884 | 0.890 | 0.57 s | $0.25 |
| claude few-shot | 0.914 | 0.904 | 0.924 | 0.914 | 0.56 s | $0.72 |

## Cascade (estimate)

The shipped model answers when it is confident (80% of the messages); the rest go to Claude. Computed from the two sets of stored predictions on the same 210 phrases; the confidence threshold was fixed on training data. An estimate, not implemented, and on a small set the third decimal is noise.

| Classifier | Macro-F1 | ES | PT | Sent to Claude | Added time (mean) | Cost per 1,000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| shipped model alone | 0.853 | 0.797 | 0.905 | 0% | 0 ms | $0.00 |
| claude zero-shot on every message | 0.890 | 0.896 | 0.884 | 100% | 566 ms | $0.25 |
| cascade: shipped model, claude zero-shot when not confident | 0.918 | 0.875 | 0.962 | 20% | 111 ms | $0.05 |
| claude few-shot on every message | 0.914 | 0.904 | 0.924 | 100% | 562 ms | $0.72 |
| cascade: shipped model, claude few-shot when not confident | 0.914 | 0.864 | 0.962 | 20% | 110 ms | $0.14 |
